objectiveBriefs.bounce_cure: Their auto-debit failed. Find out whether it was a timing problem or a money problem, and agree how the instalment gets paid.
objectiveBriefs.broken_ptp_chase: They promised to pay and the date has passed. Refer to the promise they made, without reproach, and agree a new one you both believe.
objectiveBriefs.callback_honour: They asked us to call back at this time. They are expecting you — open by saying so.
objectiveBriefs.cross_sell: They are eligible for a product. Mention it once, briefly, and stop if they are not interested.
objectiveBriefs.document_chase: A document we need is outstanding. Explain which, why, and how to send it.
objectiveBriefs.dpd_reminder: Their account is overdue. State the position plainly and without pressure, find out why, and agree a way forward.
objectiveBriefs.hardship_intake: They have told us they are in difficulty. Listen, capture the reason, and offer the paths that exist. Do not negotiate and do not sell.
objectiveBriefs.mandate_reregistration: Their auto-debit mandate is cancelled or invalid, so no payment can reach us however willing they are. This call is about fixing that, not about the arrears.
objectiveBriefs.manual_outbound: A colleague asked for this call to be placed.
objectiveBriefs.pre_due_reminder: Their instalment is due shortly and has not been paid. Remind them warmly — this is a courtesy, not a chase — and confirm they can pay on time.
objectiveBriefs.retention_save: They have signalled they may leave. Understand why before offering anything.
objectiveBriefs.welcome_onboarding: Their loan has just started. Walk them through the first instalment and confirm the auto-debit is set up. Nothing is overdue.
